description: Tesco PLC is a British multinational groceries and general merchandise retailer, operating supermarkets and convenience stores across the UK and several European countries. It is the largest supermarket chain in the UK with approximately 28% market share, and ranks among the top 20 largest retailers globally by revenue. Beyond groceries, Tesco offers financial services, clothing, electronics, and fuel, and operates a major loyalty programme (Clubcard).
key_facts: Founded in 1919 by Jack Cohen, initially as a market stall in Hackney, London
Market leader in UK grocery retail with approximately 28.4% market share as of recent data
Listed on the London Stock Exchange and a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index
Operates internationally in Czech Republic, Ireland, Slovakia, Hungary, and the Isle of Man, having previously exited markets in Asia and the US
